name: MyPup
summary:
🎮 All pet owners, gather up! The VR game "My Puppy" has had a super cool upgrade!
With this update, the game scenes have been upgraded with a full-fledged anime style, which is both cute and dreamy. It will instantly transport you into a wonderful dog world just like in a fairy tale. The joyful world has been upgraded with a variety of interactive gameplay such as frisbee and ball games, making it extremely fun. The dog family has expanded significantly.
